name: FaceContext — Alerta de Gastos Gemini
description: I will check the Gemini API usage for the current month via the fcProxy function (?action=usage), calculate how much of the R$100 budget has been spent, and send a WhatsApp message to the owner with a summary: total spent in BRL, % of budget used, remaining budget, and number of API calls. If usage is above 80%, I will add a warning alert.
